title: Temerari, sortite… Come scoglio
subtitle: Fiordiligi: recitative and aria from Così fan tutte, Act 1 (No. 14)

passages.label: Come scoglio · Così ognor quest' alma
Con noi nacque quella face · far che cangi affetto il cor
Rispettate, anime ingrate (Più Allegro, to the end)

licences.notes: Words as printed in the Peters vocal score (degl' infami, printed degl 'infami; quest' alma and nell' amor as two words; speraza, the print's spelling of the long run on speranza in bars 119–126). The first bar's -ciamo?, Dorabella's only notes here, ends her Sorella, che facciamo? from the recitative before.

licences.source: Edition Peters vocal score (Edition Peters Nr. 4474, plate 11446, edited by Georg Schünemann), pages 112–120, bars 1–153 of No. 14
licences.author: Kurt Soldan (1891–1946), piano reduction
licences.notes: Written out from the printed pages: sung lines and piano each read by two independent readers, every disagreement settled on the page by a judge (in three page ranges: the recitative, pp. 114–117 and pp. 118–120), a separate sweep for dynamics and other marks, then checked bar by bar by four fresh checkers (one error found and corrected: the right hand in bar 38 is in two voices). The German singing translation is left out. Bar 1 begins with Dorabella's -ciamo?, the end of the recitative before; she has a staff of rests after it. The aria begins at bar 26 (Andante maestoso), with Allegro at bar 40 and Più Allegro at bar 104. Kept as printed: the editorial f in brackets in bar 26. Left out: a small-note alternative (B flat 4) printed under the main B flat 5 in bar 38. The two small notes after the trill in bars 71–72 are written as grace notes at the start of bar 72; the fermatas printed as a dot under the slur in bars 85, 87 and 102 are written as fermatas. Playback tempo: the recitative ♩ = 80 (estimated); the aria ♩ = 66, then ♩ = 126 (bar 40) and ♩ = 144 (bar 104), set so the aria lasts about 4½ minutes, as in Jacobs (4:29); Mozart gives the words Allegro, Andante maestoso, Allegro and Più Allegro only.
